title: A 2026 survey says 4 in 10 urban professionals report high stress, up from about 1 in 3 last year. Bangaloreans, what actually helps you switch off after work?
text:
Saw the Workforce Health Index 2026 numbers from Loop Health. High reported stress went from 33.9% to 40.4% in a year, and among the high-stress group about 41% were also short on sleep.

That matches what I see around me. The commute eats an hour or two, US calls run late, and by the time the laptop closes it's 11 and the brain is still running.

I'm curious what works for people in this city specifically. A walk in Cubbon on weekends, a hard stop on Slack, gym after work, no screens in the bedroom? Or have you just accepted it as the price of living here?

(Disclosure: I run a small supplement company, so weigh my take accordingly. No products or links in this post.)
